sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 6 月 18 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、SPCX、MSFT、WDC、SNDK。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Semiconductor/memory faith bull run fully erupts, single-handedly carrying the market: 26 minutes after the open (09:56 ET), QQQ +1.55% ($733.67) led the gains, while SPY was only +0.46% ($744.43) and DIA +0.26%—the rally was almost entirely driven by chips. WDC +10.5% ($787), SNDK +8% ($2118), MU +5.6% (breaking $1100 to $1102), ARM +6%, MRVL +7.6%, AVGO +4.1%, AMD +3.5%, and SOXL surged 15.4%. The catalyst was Apple’s Tim Cook warning that memory/storage costs have become "unsustainable" and will drive product price hikes, combined with investment banks consecutively raising MU price targets. The community spammed "DRAM and chill."
  • Intel surges, Trump names Apple partnership: INTC +7.2% ($130, briefly touching $135 intraday). Trump said on Truth Social that Apple agreed to design and manufacture chips with Intel in the U.S., and mentioned Nvidia would also work with Intel on first-layer chips. Note: neither Intel nor Apple has officially confirmed this; the news comes only from the president’s social media. NVDA +1.6% ($208).
  • SpaceX (SPCX) IPO myth collapses: The stock is not in the real-time quote source. According to the community and news, it IPO’d at $135 on 6/12, surged to ~$225-230 within three days, and fell to the $185 range premarket/at the open today, with repeated violent intraday sweeps to $150-$160 and "glitch" moves. Shorts were able to short it for the first time as options and borrowable shares became available. The lockup expires in phases (first 20% at the end of July, all 180-day shares unlocked on 12/8, Musk’s holdings locked until 2027/6).
  • Space sector dragged down across the board by SpaceX: ASTS -9.7% ($77), RKLB -6.3% ($101), LUNR -6.4%. The community spammed resentment that "SpaceX goes up and others fall; SpaceX goes down and others still fall."
  • Software/MAG7 continue to surrender: ACN plunged 16.6% after earnings ($130, cutting full-year guidance), dragging IBM -7% ($244); MSFT -1% ($375), GOOGL -1.3%, CRM -2.7% (breaking below $150), NOW -2.2%, PLTR -3.6%, TSLA -2.1%.
  • Geopolitics and macro: The U.S.-Iran "memorandum of understanding (MOU)" was widely mocked by the community as "fake peace/surrender," while WTI oil fell below $80 (Ukraine’s attack on a Moscow refinery created disruption). Fed’s Warsh was hawkish yesterday, and the market focused on "rate-hike worries" but chose to ignore them today. Today is quadruple witching + SPX rebalancing; the market is closed tomorrow for Juneteenth, creating a four-day break.

社区氛围：整体“撕裂狂潮”——一方面是内存/半导体牛市的极度兴奋（MU/WDC/SNDK被叫到天价）；另一方面，软件/MAG7 和航天领域持有者集体哀嚎，论坛上充斥着 SPCX 清算帖子。表面上看涨情绪，但背后隐藏着对“四重巫术+长周末”的不信任以及削减实力的冲动。

恐惧/贪婪：半导体方面极度贪婪（WDC一周内+60%，RSI 99，但仍然被买入）；软件/太空领域出现恐慌性抛售。整体偏向贪婪，但又极度发散。

情绪与实际走势：社区情绪与盘面高度一致——QQ真的涨了，SPY滞后了，软件红了，空间塌了，这些都实时反映在评论中。唯一的偏差是，社区将开盘扫荡戏剧化为“V形陷阱/算法操纵”，但截至目前QQQ仍稳稳保持在+1.5%。
